data.name: Use Items Anywhere
data.teaser: Keybind items for Quick Use from anywhere!
data.description:
Features and Usage

Features

Set Quick Use keybinds for items anywhere in your player inventory.

In vanilla Tarkov you can set Quick Use keybinds to items in your

  • Pockets
  • Tactical Rig
  • Special Slots

This mod allows you to also set Quick Use keybinds to items in your

  • Backpack
  • Secured Container
  • other containers nested in one of the above containers.
    • ex: a Zagustin Injector inside of an injector case. That injector case could then be
      • just in your pocket
      • or inside a rig, inside a backpack, in the backpack on your player

Usage

Set Quick Use keybinds exactly as you do in vanilla!

Hover

  1. Find the item you want to keybind for Quick Use
  2. Hover your mouse over that item
  3. Press the keybind to which you want to set the item under your mouse cursor

Drag

  1. Find the item you want to keybind for Quick Use
  2. Drag that item onto the Quick Use slot to which you want to set that item

(If there are other methods in vanilla to set Quick Use keybinds, they probably work as well but please let me know because I’d love to learn about them!)

Installation

This must be installed on all clients and the raid host. If you use a headless/dedicated client, it must be installed there as well.

Extract zip and drop BepInEx folder inside of your SPTarkov folder

Demonstration Video (this is for SAIN, which also has a user folder, but the same concept applies to all of my mods). Credit to Drakia for the video

Known Issues

Fika

For full functionality, the mod must be installed on all clients (so it must be installed on a headless client if you’re using one). If the mod is not installed on the client hosting the raid, you will be limited to vanilla-behavior while in raid.

  • You can only add bindings to items in your pockets or rig for the duration of the raid.
  • The bindings created while out of raid are kept and will continue to work during the raid
Credits

Original Mod by Dirtbikercj. Re-posted for 3.11 with permission.

Please show him lots of love. I’ve agreed to handle maintenance going forward but he’s the real creator. He’s given a lot to this community and deserves all the credit and praise, and none of the grief that’s been shown him in the past. I hope he makes his way back to modding but I wish him the best regardless.

Edit: Cj is back to modding! I will keep this for 3.11 but he will be taking over maintenance, starting with SPT 4.0. See https://forge.sp-tarkov.com/mod/2386/use-items-anywhere
